curated-gf-edu-au-vic-wa-nt-hand-gf-anti: Graceful hand-lettered curves lead in Edu AU VIC WA NT Hand, hollow and constant like glass tubing. Antic Didone answers with hairline tips on fat strokes, a dazzling push and pull.
curated-gf-edu-au-vic-wa-nt-pre-gf-tasa-: Low, loose and casually penned. TASA Orbiter keeps its small counters open and tidy, so Edu AU VIC WA NT Pre can stay chatty above it (say, on custom embroidery patches).
curated-gf-edu-vic-wa-nt-beginner-plus-j: Plus Jakarta Sans builds every curve from one line weight, with endings held well apart. Its sans-serif lettering sits taller than the low, cable-outline hand of Edu VIC WA NT Beginner, so brief copy goes down easily.
curated-gf-edu-vic-wa-nt-hand-pre-gf-tsu: Crayon on rough paper, low and loose. Edu VIC WA NT Hand Pre earns its place big and short, while Tsukimi Rounded brings parallel-edged round letters.
curated-gf-elsie-gf-esteban: Esteban sets its serif lowercase large beside the capitals, with hairlines only slightly finer than the stems. Elsie is best at chunky stems joined by threadlike strokes, while Esteban handles quieter text.
curated-gf-elsie-instrument-sans: Ribbon-fat stems, hairline threads. Elsie earns its keep big and brief, and Instrument Sans keeps pencil-like lines beneath it, handy for an about us team page.
curated-gf-elsie-swash-caps-gf-noto-sans: Stout stems pulled against delicate crossbars define Elsie Swash Caps, and its tension could carry personal trainer branding. Noto Sans Mandaic follows with curvy, unclamped letters that read smoothly in a few lines.
curated-gf-engagement-sora: Tight, scribbled and nearly touching. Sora is the pair's strongest card, with a crisp geometric build whose curves turn corners without swelling, a good foil for a line of memoir notes.
curated-gf-ephesis-gf-montaga: Montaga reads bookish and editorial, with open loops left unfinished. Ephesis is best at tucked, crowded, folded-over letters, while Montaga is best at threadlike, steady strokes.
curated-gf-ephesis-gf-sanchez: Sanchez reads dignified and bookish, its c opened like calipers, perhaps on a scrapbook page. Ephesis folds its letters shut into a friendly, shallow tangle, while Sanchez holds them open and taller.
